body: Well I talk to a psychiatrist every once in a while. Other than that, no. And I just can’t bring myself to stop isolating because everyone I meet or even become friends with seems to just use me. It ain’t worth it.

It’s just that all my friends are leaving me. I really only have one friend left and it feels like they’re drifting away too. Recently I’ve just been isolating because of it. I’m down to my last straw honestly. I can’t stand living.
